_instructions: A separate managed policy because the main deployer policy is close to
IAM's 6,144-character limit for one managed policy.
Copy this file to iam-deployer-dynamodb-policy.json, replace
YOUR_AWS_ACCOUNT_ID, and create it via IAM → Policies → Create policy → JSON.
Attach it to the deployer user and to the GitHub deploy role (secrets.AWS_ROLE_ARN).
